findings: A law dated before it was signed
Law n° 02-01 (electricity and gas) is dated 27 April 1991 in the register; it was signed in 2002.
An amendment applied to the wrong text
Law n° 08-12, which amends ordinance n° 03-03 on competition, is applied to law n° 03-03 on tourist expansion zones: since 2008, 24 of its articles carry the competition text.
Texts that run on into the next law
Laws n° 04-06 and 04-09 carry on with the articles of the laws printed after them in the Journal officiel (201 files).
A law missing from the register
Organic law n° 26-05, applied in the history, is missing from data/laws.csv.
Repealed articles still in the text
25 articles that other laws in the repository repeal are still in its Penal Code.
Two laws holding another document’s text
The files of the Law on Children and the Law on Militia and Self-defence Forces hold part of another document’s text.
34 versions promulgated but not yet in force are recorded for 31 December 2117, which stands for no day.
The record does not hold Royal Decree-law 4/2020.
The list of acts with links (registry/data/acts.json) predates 3,466 acts, which have no links yet.
One act fixing the maritime domain (cadastral municipality Split, 2003) gives coordinates in the open sea: a misprinted zone digit.
For 18 entries the Gazette’s issue lists name the High Representative as the issuer of other institutions’ acts.
Some titles in the issue lists are cut short, those of issue 3/03 among them.
Dates that disagree with the bulletin
Two laws of 1993 are dated a day after the bulletin that publishes them; the preamble and signature of Law 2/2025 of 23 January say “2024”.
